consequence.statement: This is an additive feature that extends AuthorizationPolicy capabilities on waypoints without affecting existing configurations.

original.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds support for the connection.sni rule in AuthorizationPolicy when applied to waypoints.

decision.reason: [ev-fee07e326846] only says that support for the `connection.sni` rule was added for AuthorizationPolicy applied to a waypoint. That is an additive capability: nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or has to be migrated if the operator does nothing. So "none" (informational) fits the evidence. Confidence is low because the note does not say how waypoints treated this rule before 1.24.0.
